basic_profile.bio: Gamer and tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I spend most of my free time exploring new strategies in GTA Online and diving deep into the Marvel universe. I'm a software developer by day, working remotely, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies. I'm single and enjoy late-night gaming sessions, especially on weekends. I'm also part of a local gaming community where we often organize LAN parties and share gaming tips.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been gaming since my early teens. My expertise in games like GTA Online comes from years of playing and engaging with online forums and communities. I stay updated with the latest game patches and strategies through Reddit and YouTube channels.
